## Problem

What is broken or missing? Describe the behavior without confidential or identifying material.

## Concrete scenario

Describe a minimal reproduction using synthetic data only. Include the command, relevant file path or expected/actual
behavior, but remove real borrower information, secrets and production content.

## Proposed fix

What change would address the problem?

## Acceptance criteria

What observable behavior or checks would demonstrate that the issue is fixed?

## Evidence

Use synthetic inputs, redacted output, test results or public documentation. Do not attach confidential documents,
real customer data, API keys or tokens.
